request.query: query Qaa460Inventory($ownerId:String!){services(ownerId:$ownerId){id name type} databases(ownerId:$ownerId){id name} keyValues(ownerId:$ownerId){id name} projects(ownerId:$ownerId){id name} envGroups(ownerId:$ownerId){id name} blueprints(ownerId:$ownerId){id name} webhookEndpoints(ownerId:$ownerId){id name url eventTypes enabled}}

mutation CreateKeyValue($name: String!, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $plan: String, $version: String, $storageGB: Int, $public: Boolean, $maxmemoryPolicy: String, $persistenceMode: String) {
  createKeyValue(
    name: $name
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    plan: $plan
    version: $version
    storageGB: $storageGB
    public: $public
    maxmemoryPolicy: $maxmemoryPolicy
    persistenceMode: $persistenceMode
  ) {
    id
    name
    plan
    status
    projectId
    environmentId
    __typename
  }
}

query KeyValue($id: String!) {
  keyValue(id: $id) {
    id
    name
    plan
    version
    status
    statusReason
    statusReasonCode
    suspended
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    externalHost
    public
    region
    __typename
  }
}
